**3B.5 Research Note**

Bottom line: the 2024 record is **mostly negative**. I found evidence that Erdoğan’s government used anti-terror / administrative powers to pressure and control opponents, while the main pro-side evidence is limited to narrow civilian safety administration and emergency-preparedness activity, not broader rights-protective restraint.

| Polarity | Title | Publisher | Date | Recoverable URL | Claim-level summary | Question IDs |
|---|---|---:|---|---|---|---|
| Negative | [World Report 2024: Türkiye](https://www.hrw.org/world-report/2024/country-chapters/turkey) | Human Rights Watch | 2024 | https://www.hrw.org/world-report/2024/country-chapters/turkey | HRW says the government’s security apparatus and courts were used in ways that kept torture, custody abuse, and political repression largely unchecked, rather than narrowly and lawfully controlled. | 3B.5; 3B.1; 3B.2 |
| Negative | [Türkiye government removes elected opposition mayors](https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/11/07/turkiye-government-removes-elected-opposition-mayors) | Human Rights Watch | 2024-11-06 | https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/11/07/turkiye-government-removes-elected-opposition-mayors | Erdoğan’s government removed elected mayors, dissolved councils, detained a mayor on terrorism charges, and police violently dispersed protests. This is strong evidence of administrative control and anti-terror tools being used for intimidation and political control. | 3B.5; 3B.2; 3B.1 |
| Negative | [Türkiye: Kurdish politicians convicted in unjust mass trial](https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/05/16/turkiye-kurdish-politicians-convicted-unjust-mass-trial) | Human Rights Watch | 2024-05-16 | https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/05/16/turkiye-kurdish-politicians-convicted-unjust-mass-trial | A Turkish court convicted 24 Kurdish politicians in what HRW calls a manifestly political trial on bogus state-security charges, indicating security law used for repression rather than lawful restraint. | 3B.5; 3B.1; 3B.2 |
| Negative | [Freedom in the World 2024: Turkey](https://freedomhouse.org/country/turkey/freedom-world/2024) | Freedom House | 2024 | https://freedomhouse.org/country/turkey/freedom-world/2024 | Freedom House says due process was severely compromised, courts often ignored higher-court rulings, and prosecutors did not consistently investigate torture or custody abuse. That undercuts any claim of narrowly lawful use of coercive state power. | 3B.5; 3B.4; 3B.1 |
| Positive, narrow | [Ministry inspectors visited Akkuyu construction site](https://guvenliinsaat.csgb.gov.tr/haberler/akkuyu-nukleer-guc-santrali-inşaatını-ziyaret-ettik/) | T.C. Çalışma ve Sosyal Güvenlik Bakanlığı | 2024-04-02 | https://guvenliinsaat.csgb.gov.tr/haberler/akkuyu-nukleer-guc-santrali-inşaatını-ziyaret-ettik/ | Labor inspectors visited Akkuyu under a cooperation protocol and discussed occupational safety fixes. This is evidence of limited, rule-bound administrative oversight in a safety context, not coercive emergency-power use. | 3B.5; 2B.8 |
| Positive, narrow | [AFAD 3rd International CBRN Congress](https://cbrn2024.afad.gov.tr/en/?mbaopn=1) | AFAD | 2024-11-20 to 2024-11-22 | https://cbrn2024.afad.gov.tr/en/?mbaopn=1 | AFAD’s CBRN congress included radiological/nuclear emergency management, experts, and regulators. This supports institutional preparedness and civilian risk management, though it does not show broader rights-respecting emergency governance. | 3B.5; 2B.8 |
| Positive, narrow | [AFAD says congress brought together UN, IAEA, OPCW, experts](https://www.afad.gov.tr/afad-tarafindan-duzenlenen-3-uluslararasi-kbrn-kongresi-devam-ediyor) | AFAD | 2024-11-21 | https://www.afad.gov.tr/afad-tarafindan-duzenlenen-3-uluslararasi-kbrn-kongresi-devam-ediyor | AFAD emphasized cooperation with international expert bodies on CBRN threats. This is evidence of bureaucratic, expert-led preparedness rather than emergency powers used as intimidation. | 3B.5; 2B.8 |

**Search gap**

I did **not** find strong 2024 evidence that Erdoğan used emergency powers or security laws in a narrowly lawful, rights-protective way. The credible positive material is mostly about **technical safety oversight** and **civilian emergency preparedness**, while the stronger evidence shows **administrative and anti-terror controls being used for political pressure and repression**.
